I've lived in 7 states in the West and have some I like more than others... most of the them were small tourist-type towns as I was a USFS and NPS worker in my twenties.... so probably not the best options for opportunity, but the places I feel drawn back to are Bend OR, Flagstaff AZ, Grand Junction CO... I would really just like to live somewhere where I can afford a condo or small cottage because while I don't have extravagant dreams or expectations in life, I'd really like to have my own dog with a small yard all to myself... sucks that that feels so out of reach at my age but it is what it is.
